title: E-GRV-0043: the multipole kinematics of an unequal-mass binary in its centre-of-mass frame: the monopole is constant...
purpose: Experiment E-GRV-0043 in the gravity arena: the multipole kinematics of an unequal-mass binary in its centre-of-mass frame: the monopole is constant and the mass dipole vanishes from momentum conservation (not input symmetry, the masses are 2 and 1), while the quadrupole oscillates at twice the orbital frequency, so given the standard multipole radiation rule (stated, not derived here) the wave comes out at 2 f_orb, the cos(2 phi) LIGO signature that E-GRV-0016 hardcoded.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
